verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe using llamafile with multimodal models (Qwen3.5, Ministral3, llava1.6) to describe jpg/png/gif/bmp images. The quickstart also documents a `/upload` command for attaching images in chat. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of vision use, deeper documentation of the supported vision model list and API-level image input (e.g., via the server), and evidence of pre-built multimodal llamafiles.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run vision-language models that understand images alongside text

citations.quote: Here's how you can use llamafile to describe a jpg/png/gif/bmp image with a multimodal model (Qwen3.5, Ministral3, llava1.6 are all good candidates)
you can also upload an image by using the `/upload` command and specifying the path to the image
